description: Footwear made in Tangerang, Indonesia (one article at a sister factory in Vietnam), sold by a Singapore trading company to a Columbus, OH retailer, CFR Savannah. Text invoice (Gill Sans, YYYY.MM.DD dates, PRS units, HTS in the last column, itemized ocean freight inside the CFR price, footnoted Vietnam-origin line); the factory packing list is a JPEG phone photo (2.1° rotation, uneven light, slight blur, 1600 px wide, per-colour rows); NVOCC house B/L (text) with its SCAC printed apart from the house number and an SCAC-prefixed master B/L, Tanjung Priok via Singapore to Savannah, 1 x 40' GP, freight prepaid, ORIGINAL.
notes: Valuation policy: CFR Savannah — the line prices include ocean freight to Savannah, which the invoice itemizes ("Value breakdown (included in the CFR prices above)": FOB value 109,950.00 + ocean freight 4,350.00 = CFR 114,300.00). International freight is non-dutiable and is deducted, prorated by line value. No insurance (CFR), no assists, no NCV lines.
Total entered value: 51,425 + 37,054 + 21,471 = 109,950 (= FOB value 109,950.00 printed in the breakdown). USD, no conversion.

HTS (real 2026 HTSUS 8-digit codes, cached in scripts/synthetic/reference/): 6404.11.90 sports footwear with rubber soles and textile uppers valued over $12/pair (20%) — the entered value per pair is 51,425.43 / 3,600 = 14.28, still over $12 after the freight deduction; 6403.99.90 leather-upper footwear not covering the ankle, for persons other than men, valued over $2.50/pair (10%); 6402.99.31 rubber/plastic-upper footwear (uppers over 90% plastics), not one-piece molded, other (6%).

Origin: header says INDONESIA "except the article marked *"; line 2 (SNA-LW3105, women's leather loafer) is footnoted as made by NUSANTARA FOOTWEAR VIETNAM CO., LTD., Lot C-7, Nhon Trach 3 Industrial Park, Hiep Phuoc Town, Nhon Trach District, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam → line 2 COO VN, ORIGIN_DIFFERS; its MID must come from the Vietnamese factory. Lines 1 and 3 COO ID (manufacturer PT SEPATU NUSANTARA ABADI, Tangerang). Country of export is Indonesia for all lines.

Seller STRAITSBRIDGE SOURCING PTE. LTD. (Singapore) is a trading company, not the manufacturer (invoice box "Goods made & shipped by" = PT SEPATU NUSANTARA ABADI; the B/L shipper is the factory "O/B" the trader) → SELLER_NOT_MANUFACTURER. A FIRST_SALE_OPPORTUNITY advisory is plausible but not asserted.

Packing list (JPEG photo, factory-issued) rows are per colour: SNA-RN2208 1,800 + 1,800 PRS, SNA-LW3105 1,800 PRS, SNA-SL0410 2,400 + 2,400 PRS; per-article sums equal the invoice quantities, so QTY_MISMATCH must not fire. Totals 650 cartons, 10,200 PRS, N.W. 5,940.0 kg, G.W. 6,880.0 kg, 57.00 m³; the B/L agrees (650 CARTONS, 6,880.000 kg, 57.000 m³).

House B/L: the house number JKSAV260917 is printed without a prefix and the NVOCC SCAC TSGL is printed separately in the letterhead → houseScac TSGL + houseBill JKSAV260917. Master KRMLJKT260944718 → master SCAC KRML + bill JKT260944718. Both bills present → HOUSE_MASTER_BILL.

Container KRMU7182948 passes ISO 6346 (check digit 8), seal KS2260917, 40' GP. Routing Jakarta (Tanjung Priok) → Singapore (transhipment) → Savannah; discharge SAVANNAH, GA → Schedule D 1703, containerized vessel → mode 11. The final destination COLUMBUS, OH is for information only.
Dates: invoice 2026.09.11 and ETD 2026.09.19 are year-first YYYY.MM.DD (unambiguous: no one writes YYYY.DD.MM), so DATE_AMBIGUOUS must not fire. B/L shipped on board 19 SEP 2026.

Freight PREPAID and an ORIGINAL house B/L (3 originals, "ORIGINAL B/L REQUIRED FOR RELEASE"); no telex release, so TELEX_RELEASE must not fire. Consignee = invoice buyer (OLENTANGY RETAIL GROUP, INC.).
